text_block_list.text:
When I visited the waiting room, Mejiro Ryan was
furiously doing squats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm just so frustrated by the last race results...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Muscles grow tough and resilient
precisely through the load you put on them like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I feel the exact same way...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because we lost that we can
overcome our frustration and grow!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm much stronger than before, and I'll prove it with a win today—!
